# bolognese

**Tag**: data

## 简介

Ruby gem and command-line utility for conversion of DOI metadata from and to different metadata formats, including schema.org.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/datacite/bolognese
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/bolognese/2.7.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/bolognese
